note: widthOffset = --window-size width minus the page's reported innerWidth. Measured with smoke.py --calibrate (neutral first probe, then a verification launch per width); it differs per browser family and clamps below about 500 px, so the runner always re-checks the reported innerWidth and FAILs on a mismatch.
